LEFT JOIN mes_md_item product_item ON product_item.id = work_order.product_id AND product_item.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id AND product_item.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN system_users actual_employee ON actual_employee.id = pool_event.actual_employee_id AND actual_employee.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id AND actual_employee.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_pro_process_pool_team_employee_profile actual_employee_profile_by_id ON actual_employee_profile_by_id.id = pool_event.actual_employee_id AND actual_employee_profile_by_id.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id AND actual_employee_profile_by_id.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, system_user_id, display_name, employee_name FROM ( SELECT profile.tenant_id, profile.system_user_id, profile.display_name, profile.employee_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY profile.tenant_id, profile.system_user_id ORDER BY profile.enabled DESC, profile.update_time DESC, profile.id DESC ) AS row_rank FROM mes_pro_process_pool_team_employee_profile profile WHERE profile.deleted = 0 AND profile.system_user_id IS NOT NULL ) ranked_profile WHERE ranked_profile.row_rank = 1 ) actual_employee_profile_by_user ON actual_employee_profile_by_user.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id AND actual_employee_profile_by_user.system_user_id = pool_event.actual_employee_id LEFT JOIN mes_pqc_inspection_task pqc_task ON pqc_task.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id AND pqc_task.deleted = 0 AND pool_event.feedback_source_type = 'MES_PQC_INSPECTION_TASK' AND pqc_task.id = pool_event.pqc_task_id

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, event_id, leader_user_id, review_status, review_remark, reviewed_at FROM ( SELECT review_log.tenant_id, review_log.event_id, review_log.leader_user_id, review_log.review_status, review_log.review_remark, review_log.reviewed_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY review_log.tenant_id, review_log.event_id ORDER BY review_log.reviewed_at DESC, review_log.id DESC ) AS review_rank FROM mes_pro_process_pool_submission_review review_log WHERE review_log.deleted = 0 ) ranked_review WHERE ranked_review.review_rank = 1 ) latest_submission_review ON latest_submission_review.event_id = pool_event.id AND latest_submission_review.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN system_users review_leader ON review_leader.id = latest_submission_review.leader_user_id AND review_leader.tenant_id = pool_event.tenant_id AND review_leader.deleted = 0
